q.en: Who is the author of 'The Discovery of India'?
q.as: 'The Discovery of India' ৰ লেখক কোন?

explanation.en: 'The Discovery of India' was written by Jawaharlal Nehru during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort.
explanation.as: 'The Discovery of India' জৱাহৰলাল নেহৰুৱে আহমদনগৰ দুৰ্গত কাৰাবাসৰ সময়ত লিখিছিল।
